entries.claim: This setting prints the 17-word collecta proper w001–w017, followed by the distinct abbreviated cue “Per Dóminum.” The full supplied ending and Amen are not printed at this proper locus. The printed feast heading identifies Boniface as a commemoration.

locator.section: RG115a complete ending and Amen wording; same-edition accented common stem and terminal typography

entries.claim: RG115a supplies the Father-directed Per Dominum ending w018–w038 and Amen w039. Its literal rubric formula is unaccented. Same-edition p.123 controls matching accented formula words, and p.226 controls the accented four-word terminal and separately marked Amen period. These controls do not make the proper page a full-ending witness or establish response actors, singing, or larger-group conclusion distribution.
